sentences.text: In short: DINTANNLEGE AS is a young company in "tannlegetjenester" based in Ullensaker, profitable in 2025.
DINTANNLEGE AS is registered in the industry "Tannlegetjenester"; its registered activity is "Tannlegetjenester".
DINTANNLEGE AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2021-12-22, registered in Ullensaker.
It reported revenue of NOK 5.64M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 757,232 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 13.4% and a strong equity ratio of 49% of total assets.

Revenue fell 3.0% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 5.82M to NOK 5.64M); it was NOK 5.68M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 836,503, 2024: NOK 990,060, 2025: NOK 589,046).
In the register's group structure, DINTANNLEGE AS is 100% owned by DINT AS (828422812).
DINTANNLEGE AS is led by Leon Nhat Tran Nguyen, who is both CEO and board chair.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-01-19 (within the past year).
